entries.text: 這裡的冷氣也開得太冷了吧。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_first_01

entries.text: 原來是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳叫我來的？[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_00

entries.text: ……知道嗎？\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這樣做很冷欸。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_01

entries.text: 我不覺得把我叫來\n對這學園有什麼好處。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_02

entries.text: 沒那回事！
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_select_01

entries.text: ……說得真肯定啊。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳那份自信究竟是從哪裡來的？[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_03

entries.text: 看吧……\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也沒有自信對吧？[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_03b

entries.text: 但是既然來了，\n我還是會好好工作的。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_04

entries.text: 畢竟……\n我也是專業的。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳去過生態巨蛋的極地區嗎？\n那裡真的很厲害。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_01

entries.text: 那裡的雪鬆軟得簡直像是天然的一樣，\n讓人難以相信那是人工雪。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_02

entries.text: 直線道和彎道都很充實，\n很適合單板滑雪。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_03

entries.text: 你要滑雪嗎！？
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 去滑雪吧！
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_select_02

entries.text: ……啊，我不是這個意思。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_04

entries.text: 我只是改不掉只要看到雪山\n就會去觀察它的習慣而已。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_05

entries.text: 在校園裡造出那樣的山……\n這裡真是個不得了的地方。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_06

entries.text: 剛剛我去爬了極地區的雪山。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_00

entries.text: 到了不是霜抹山的雪山，\n讓走鯨牠們又高興又興奮。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_01

entries.text: 看著牠們的樣子，我也……\n稍微……站上滑雪板滑了一下。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_02

entries.text: 很好呀！
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_select_03

entries.text: 感覺如何？
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_select_04

entries.text: 呃，雪的狀態是很好。\n嗯……很好。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_03

entries.text: 好久沒有滑雪，\n連我都覺得自己太熱衷了。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_04

entries.text: 其實我本來打算\n不再站上滑雪板了……[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_05

entries.text: 但僅限在我來這裡的期間的話，\n解禁一下應該也沒關係吧。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_06

entries.text: ……抱歉啦，\n我的意志力就是這麼薄弱。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_01_00

entries.text: 既然已經這麼冷了，\n我們來做些更會冷場的事吧。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_01_01

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要不要和我\n交換寶可夢看看？[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_01_02

entries.text: 真的要交換啊？\n那我就用走鯨來交換吧，\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳呢？[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]是嗎，
嗯……不錯。\c
既然是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳託付給我的寶可夢，
我會好好培育，不會讓牠冷掉的。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_01_04

entries.text: 那就用[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n和我的走鯨交換囉。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_02_00

entries.text: 初訓家不是自己的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_02_01

entries.text: 稀有的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_02_02

entries.text: 異色的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_02_03

entries.text:
只有１隻寶可夢也太冷了，
這樣不能交換。\c
至少也要帶２隻以上的
寶可夢同行才可以。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_03_00

entries.text: ……只是開個玩笑，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳別在意。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_03_01

entries.text: 要不要做些會冷場的事？\n像是和我交換寶可夢之類的。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_trade_04_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳那副表情……\n是想和我對戰嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_talkto_00

entries.text: 放棄是正確的選擇。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_cancel_00

entries.text: 好冷的回答……\n但偶爾這樣也行吧。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 59]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: ……徹底輸了。\n現實真是冷酷呢。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 但是我很開心，\n也算是獲得了些東西。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 這是敗者送給勝者的，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳拿去吧。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 如果不需要的話就丟掉吧。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 59]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_reward_00

entries.text: 看來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳真的\n很喜歡打敗我呢。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 下次再戰的時候，\n我不會交出冰冷的成績單的。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: 就算打贏放水的[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，\n我也一點都高興不起來。\r\n下次[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳可要拿出真本事來。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: 我不擅長跟學生相處……\n想到他們將來可能會遭遇挫折，\r\n我就不忍心直視他們。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
我在這裡也算是
小有名氣的樣子。\c
纏著我拍雙人合照的人
有[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一個就很夠了。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_randomtalk_01

entries.text: 這裡的空調\n果然還是太冷了吧？\r\n我該去找誰才能調高溫度？[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_randomtalk_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]的狀況很好，\n和我的寶可夢相處得很融洽。\r\n……現在看來可沒有冷場喔。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
交換給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的
走鯨過得怎麼樣？\c
牠總是喜歡隨便亂跑，
在野餐的時候要小心看好牠。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_randomtalk_04

entries.text:
……這麼說來，
也慈跟我說了一件很冷的事。\c
聽說[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳跟她說
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳最喜歡的道館館主是我。\c
雖然我真的是完全無法理解
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是怎麼得出那種答案的……\c
但我還是收到[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的心意了……
姑且跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳說聲謝謝。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]
entries.label: coach_gym_koori_randomtalk_sp
